verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web app, so headless automation is a fair axis. The evidence offers some programmatic hooks: a beta Agent Management API that authenticates machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities, a published openapi.json, a Scheduled Chats feature, and container/Helm deployment that fits CI pipelines. Nothing shows a CLI or a documented way to run conversations headlessly or from CI, and the main machine-facing API is beta and scoped to agent management. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless run mode, documented CI/automation workflows, a stable (non-beta) API for running chats or agents programmatically, and independent hands-on corroboration.
